sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The question is on the adoption of the resolution.
sentences.zh: 现在表决关于采纳该决议的问题。

sentences.en: The House of Representatives took its first vote to begin an impeachment inquiry into President
sentences.zh: 众议院进行了首次投票，以启动对特朗普总统的弹劾调查，

sentences.en: Trump, launching a new phase of the process, directed at the public.
sentences.zh: 开启了该程序面向公众的新阶段。

sentences.en: Those in favor, please say aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成者请说“赞成”。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Julie Davis on what that phase will actually look like.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯将为您解读这一阶段的实际情况。

sentences.en: Those opposed, say no.
sentences.zh: 反对者请说“反对”。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月1日，星期五。

sentences.en: Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: is once again at the intersection of history on this Halloween morning, October
sentences.zh: 在这个万圣节的早晨，即2019年10月31日，
再次处于历史的交汇点。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: House getting set to do something it hasn't done in nearly 21 years, and that is begin the official impeachment process in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 众议院准备做一件近21年来未曾做过的事，那就是在美国启动正式的弹劾程序。

sentences.en: Julie, for weeks now, we have been talking about an impeachment inquiry, and we have been covering that impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，几周以来，我们一直在谈论弹劾调查，也一直在报道这项弹劾调查。

sentences.en: So what was being voted on Thursday, and why was it being voted on?
sentences.zh: 那么周四投票的内容是什么，为什么要进行这次投票？

sentences.en: So what was being voted on Thursday was a resolution to essentially just lay out the rules for the
sentences.zh: 周四投票的内容是一项决议，本质上只是为正在进行的

sentences.en: impeachment inquiry that's underway and allow the Democrats to take this into the next phase, which is going to be a public phase of their investigation.
sentences.zh: 弹劾调查制定规则，并允许民主党人将其推进到下一阶段，也就是调查的公开阶段。

sentences.en: Right, because what they have been doing has not been public.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他们之前所做的一切都不是公开的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when the Democrats launched their investigation about a month ago, they did not take a vote, and they were pretty clear that they didn't feel like they had to take a vote.
sentences.zh: 当民主党人大约一个月前启动调查时，他们没有进行投票，而且他们很明确地表示，他们认为自己不必进行投票。

sentences.en: The Constitution doesn't require one.
sentences.zh: 宪法并不要求投票。

sentences.en: House rules don't require one.
sentences.zh: 众议院规则也不要求投票。

sentences.en: And privately, they felt like politically, it might not be the easiest vote for some of their members to take.
sentences.zh: 私下里，他们觉得从政治上讲，这对他们的一些成员来说可能不是最容易投的一票。

sentences.en: So they had been going along, taking private depositions, collecting their facts.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在进行私下取证，收集事实。

sentences.en: So this was the first time that the full House was actually going to go on the record on the inquiry itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是众议院全体成员第一次就调查本身进行正式记录在案的投票。

sentences.en: And why, though?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: Because if the rules don't require it, and they were adamant that they didn't need to do it, why would they subject members to such a vote?
sentences.zh: 如果规则不要求，而且他们坚称不需要这样做，为什么还要让成员们进行这样的投票呢？

sentences.en: Well, there were practical reasons and political reasons for doing this now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在这样做既有实际原因，也有政治原因。

sentences.en: The practical reason is just there are some nuts and bolts things that they have to do in order to be able to take this inquiry into a public phase.
sentences.zh: 实际原因是，他们必须完成一些基础工作，才能将这项调查推进到公开阶段。

sentences.en: Politically speaking, though, the public has really, in many ways, if you look at the polls, come around to this idea of having an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 不过从政治上讲，如果你看看民调，公众在很多方面已经开始接受进行弹劾调查的想法了。

sentences.en: There's now a majority in support of the inquiry itself.
sentences.zh: 现在多数人支持这项调查本身。

sentences.en: And many of the more moderate Democrats who had been worried about a backlash from their constituents if they signed on to something like
sentences.zh: 许多原本担心如果签署类似文件会遭到选民强烈反对的温和派民主党人，

sentences.en: this have already come out in favor of the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 都已经公开表示支持这项调查。

sentences.en: So voting for it is not really advancing them beyond where they already are at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以，投票支持它并不会让他们比现在所处的位置更进一步。

sentences.en: In other words, these Democrats are already on the diving board.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这些民主党人已经站在跳板上了。

sentences.en: They might as well just leap into the pool.
sentences.zh: 他们不如直接跳进泳池里。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's another reason, though.
sentences.zh: 不过还有另一个原因。

sentences.en: In a closed-door meeting, hearing, Marie Yovanovitch told investigators President Trump wanted her out
sentences.zh: 在闭门会议和听证会上，玛丽·约万诺维奇告诉调查人员，特朗普总统想让她离开，

sentences.en: and his attorney, Rudy Giuliani, and unnamed contacts wanted her out of the way of their money-making opportunities.
sentences.zh: 而他的律师鲁迪·朱利安尼以及一些未具名的联系人想让她离开，以免阻碍他们的赚钱机会。

sentences.en: There's been revelation after revelation, bombshell testimony that have produced some really damaging information about the president.
sentences.zh: 爆料接二连三，重磅证词揭露了关于总统的一些非常具有破坏性的信息。

sentences.en: Bill Taylor sending shockwaves through Capitol Hill, telling Congress multiple administration
sentences.zh: 比尔·泰勒在国会山引起了轰动，他告诉国会，多名政府

sentences.en: officials informed him that President Trump personally blocked military aid unless Ukraine agreed to announce investigations into the Bidens.
sentences.zh: 官员告知他，特朗普总统亲自阻止了军事援助，除非乌克兰同意宣布对拜登家族进行调查。

sentences.en: And really confirmed some of the underlying aspects of the whistleblower complaint that started all this about his pressure campaign on Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这确实证实了举报人投诉中关于他对乌克兰施压运动的一些基本事实，而这正是这一切的开端。

sentences.en: And that is what the public has sort of embraced as the reason for the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 而这正是公众所接受的调查理由。

sentences.en: But Republicans have, from the beginning, been just railing against
sentences.zh: 但共和党人从一开始就一直在抨击

sentences.en: Democrats for running this secret process where the public can't see or hear for themselves what's transpiring.
sentences.zh: 民主党人进行这种秘密程序，让公众无法亲自看到或听到正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Republicans keep saying it's illegitimate.
sentences.zh: 共和党人一直说这是非法的。

sentences.en: This is really a fake inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一场虚假的调查。

sentences.en: You haven't voted on this.
sentences.zh: 你们还没有就此进行投票。

sentences.en: So at this point, Democrats were ready to call their bluff and say, OK, well, if you want an official vote, here's your official vote.
sentences.zh: 所以此时，民主党人准备揭穿他们的虚张声势，并说：好吧，如果你想要一次正式投票，这就是你们的正式投票。

sentences.en: The House will be in order.
sentences.zh: 众议院现在开会。

sentences.en: OK, so that brings us to Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这把我们带到了周四早上。

sentences.en: Give us the scene inside the House.
sentences.zh: 请描述一下众议院内部的情景。

sentences.en: So on Thursday morning in the House chamber, we see Nancy Pelosi, the Speaker of the House,
sentences.zh: 周四早上在众议院会议厅，我们看到众议院议长南希·佩洛西，

sentences.en: ascend to the dais at the front of the chamber where I don't remember having seen her since she became Speaker in January.
sentences.zh: 走上会议厅前方的讲台，我记得自她一月份成为议长以来，还没见过她这样做。

sentences.en: For what purpose does the gentleman from Massachusetts seek recognition?
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州的议员要求发言是为了什么目的？

sentences.en: And then she yields to Jim McGovern, who's the chairman of the Rules Committee.
sentences.zh: 然后她让位给规则委员会主席吉姆·麦戈文。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, by direction of the Committee on Rules, I call up post-Resolution 660 and ask for its immediate consideration.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，根据规则委员会的指示，我提请审议第660号决议，并要求立即进行审议。

sentences.en: Which is the committee that has drawn up this resolution, laying out the impeachment rules.
sentences.zh: 这就是起草这项决议的委员会，规定了弹劾规则。

sentences.en: The clerk will report the resolution.
sentences.zh: 书记员将宣读该决议。

sentences.en: House Calendar No.
sentences.zh: 众议院日程第

sentences.en: 52, House Resolution 660.
sentences.zh: 52号，众议院第660号决议。

sentences.en: And the House parliamentarian starts to read it.
sentences.zh: 众议院议事员开始宣读它。

sentences.en: And so everyone in the chamber at this point can hear what it is they're going to be voting on.
sentences.zh: 所以此时会议厅里的每个人都能听到他们将要投票的内容。

sentences.en: Upon recognition by the chair for such purpose under this paragraph during any hearing designated pursuant to paragraph one.
sentences.zh: 根据本段规定，在主席为此目的认可后，在根据第一段指定的任何听证会期间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I was watching this and this is pretty dense stuff.
sentences.zh: 我当时在看，这些内容相当晦涩。

sentences.en: Notwithstanding Clause 2J2 of Rule 11 of the Rules of the House.
sentences.zh: 尽管有众议院规则第11条第2J2款的规定。

sentences.en: It is pretty technical.
sentences.zh: 确实非常技术性。

sentences.en: It is full of resolves and different sections and technical legislative language that refers to different rules of the House.
sentences.zh: 它充满了决议条款、不同章节以及引用众议院不同规则的技术性立法语言。

sentences.en: But the gist of it is that essentially they're validating this inquiry that they acknowledge is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 但其要点在于，他们本质上是在确认这项他们承认正在进行的调查。

sentences.en: To whether sufficient grounds exist for the House of Representatives to exercise its constitutional power to impeach Donald John Trump, president of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 关于是否存在充分理由让众议院行使其宪法权力，弹劾美利坚合众国总统唐纳德·约翰·特朗普。

sentences.en: They're saying, we recognize that this is going on.
sentences.zh: 他们是在说，我们承认这件事正在进行。

sentences.en: Here are the rules for the coming impeachment proceedings.
sentences.zh: 以下是即将进行的弹劾程序的规则。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: One, the chair of the permanent...
sentences.zh: 第一，常设委员会主席……

sentences.en: And there's going to be a report that gets issued by the House Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会将会发布一份报告。

sentences.en: There are going to be public hearings that go on.
sentences.zh: 将会举行公开听证会。

sentences.en: And so essentially what they're doing is they're deputizing themselves as the House of Representatives, the House Intelligence Committee
sentences.zh: 所以他们本质上是在授权众议院，特别是众议院情报委员会，

sentences.en: in particular, to be the fact finders in this investigation.
sentences.zh: 成为这项调查的事实调查方。

sentences.en: In past impeachments of sitting presidents, what we've seen is they get a report from somewhere.
sentences.zh: 在过去对在任总统的弹劾中，我们看到的是他们从某处获得一份报告。

sentences.en: They get some investigative material and that becomes the grounds for whether they're going to consider articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他们获得一些调查材料，这成为他们是否考虑弹劾条款的依据。

sentences.en: But in this case, the House itself is the fact finder.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，众议院本身就是事实调查方。

sentences.en: The House Intelligence Committee is charged with coming up with the information and giving it to the Judiciary Committee and carrying
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会负责收集信息，将其交给司法委员会，并继续

sentences.en: on this process where they're going to decide whether this is worth impeaching the president or not.
sentences.zh: 进行这个程序，他们将决定是否值得弹劾总统。

sentences.en: And if there are going to be articles of impeachment, what they should say.
sentences.zh: 如果要有弹劾条款，它们应该写些什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the past, there has been an independent investigator that actually was appointed by the
sentences.zh: 过去，曾有一名由行政部门任命的独立调查员，

sentences.en: executive branch, something around the president, like a Ken Starr in the case of the Clinton impeachment or like a Robert Mueller in the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 围绕在总统身边，比如克林顿弹劾案中的肯·斯塔尔，或者俄罗斯调查中的罗伯特·穆勒。

sentences.en: That's where the report would come out, not Congress.
sentences.zh: 那是报告发布的地方，而不是国会。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is a very different case where you have an allegation that actually was initially sent.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常不同的案例，你有一个最初被提交的指控。

sentences.en: The whistleblower complaint that started all of this was referred to the Justice
sentences.zh: 引发这一切的举报人投诉曾被提交给司法

sentences.en: Department at one point and they declined to investigate it.
sentences.zh: 部，但他们拒绝调查。

sentences.en: And so clearly Democrats have made the decision.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，民主党人已经做出了决定。

sentences.en: They made it a month ago that they were going to be the ones to investigate it and have now essentially made themselves in charge of putting together a report like that on their
sentences.zh: 他们一个月前就决定由他们自己来调查，现在本质上已经让自己负责自行整理出这样一份报告。

sentences.en: own.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These rules reflect what House Democrats believe is a reality that if the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 这些规则反映了众议院民主党人认为的一个现实：如果特朗普政府

sentences.en: won't investigate the whistleblower's complaint, won't investigate this call with the president of
sentences.zh: 不调查举报人的投诉，不调查这通与乌克兰总统的通话，

sentences.en: Ukraine, then we will.
sentences.zh: 那么我们就来调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And also an acknowledgment that it's not enough for them to just investigate it to their own satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 这也承认了仅仅为了他们自己的满意而进行调查是不够的。

sentences.en: They actually have to produce a document that they can show the public that explains if they do decide to go forward with impeachment, why they're doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上必须制作一份可以向公众展示的文件，解释如果他们确实决定推进弹劾，为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, for the purposes of debate only, I yield the customary 30 minutes to the gentleman from Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，仅就辩论而言，我将惯例的30分钟时间让给俄克拉荷马州的议员。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So once these kind of nitty gritty guidelines are laid out, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么一旦这些细枝末节的指导方针确定下来，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So what happens next is a very sort of passionate 45-minute debate.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一场非常激烈的45分钟辩论。

sentences.en: This is a dark day and a cloud has fallen on this House.
sentences.zh: 这是黑暗的一天，乌云笼罩着众议院。

sentences.en: Between Republicans and Democrats over this resolution.
sentences.zh: 共和党人和民主党人围绕这项决议展开辩论。

sentences.en: It's not about, you know, the chapter and verse of the parliamentary details, but it's really about the impeachment inquiry itself.
sentences.zh: 这不是关于议事细节的条文，而是关于弹劾调查本身。

sentences.en: This is the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这是美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: Don't run a sham process, a tainted process like this resolution ensures.
sentences.zh: 不要进行虚假的程序，不要进行这项决议所确保的那种被玷污的程序。

sentences.en: It ought to be rejected, and I think you'll see bipartisan rejection of this resolution, and I yield back the balance of my time.
sentences.zh: 它应该被否决，我认为你会看到两党对这项决议的否决，我交回我剩余的时间。

sentences.en: So the Republicans say that this process has been broken from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 所以共和党人说这个程序从一开始就是破碎的。

sentences.en: It's tainted.
sentences.zh: 它是被玷污的。

sentences.en: Trying to put a ribbon on a sham process doesn't make it any less of a sham.
sentences.zh: 试图给一个虚假的程序系上丝带并不能让它减少虚假性。

sentences.en: This impeachment process is a total sham.
sentences.zh: 这个弹劾程序完全是一场闹剧。

sentences.en: You've been conducting these hearings in secret.
sentences.zh: 你们一直在秘密进行这些听证会。

sentences.en: The resolution continues the closed-door meetings that blocks entry to members of Congress and prohibits the president's due process rights.
sentences.zh: 该决议延续了闭门会议，阻止国会议员进入，并剥夺了总统的正当程序权利。

sentences.en: You've not been fair to us, and you've not been fair to the president.
sentences.zh: 你们对我们不公平，对总统也不公平。

sentences.en: So far, no matter what my colleagues say about this legislation, no matter what my colleagues
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，无论我的同事们如何评价这项立法，无论我的同事们

sentences.en: say about the process they've been engaged in to date, it is absolutely the case that it has
sentences.zh: 如何评价他们迄今为止参与的程序，事实绝对是，它一直是一个

sentences.en: been a secret process that has denied rights to the minority, that has involved leaking selectively
sentences.zh: 秘密程序，剥夺了少数党的权利，涉及选择性地泄露

sentences.en: things that the majority would like to have leaked, in which rights have absolutely been denied, and they cannot fix that.
sentences.zh: 多数党想要泄露的内容，权利绝对被剥夺了，他们无法修复这一点。

sentences.en: They cannot fix what has been a tainted record and a tainted process by now suddenly pretending they're opening it up.
sentences.zh: 他们无法通过现在突然假装开放来修复那份被玷污的记录和被玷污的程序。

sentences.en: And there's no way now to go take a vote on the House floor and just wave a magic wand and make it fair, because it's not been fair from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 现在没有办法在众议院投票，挥动魔杖让它变得公平，因为它从一开始就不公平。

sentences.en: It's not been legitimate.
sentences.zh: 它不是合法的。

sentences.en: And now at the last second, you're trying to sort of cloak it in this cloak of legitimacy, and it's just not going to
sentences.zh: 现在在最后一秒，你们试图用这种合法性的外衣来掩盖它，这根本行不通，

sentences.en: work, because this is a sham process, and it can't be remedied.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个虚假的程序，无法补救。

sentences.en: Speaker Pelosi claims she wants to establish rules and transparency.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西议长声称她想建立规则和透明度。

sentences.en: You cannot make your game fair by allowing the opposing team onto the field at the two-minute warning.
sentences.zh: 你不能在比赛还剩两分钟时允许对方球队上场，来让你的比赛变得公平。

sentences.en: They're also basically saying that...
sentences.zh: 他们基本上还在说……

sentences.en: It's clear that since the Democrats took control of the House of Representatives, they have always intended to transform the Intelligence Committee into the Impeachment
sentences.zh: 很明显，自从民主党控制众议院以来，他们一直打算将情报委员会转变为弹劾委员会。

sentences.en: Committee.
sentences.zh: 委员会。

sentences.en: Let's be honest here, Democrats.
sentences.zh: 民主党人，我们坦诚一点吧。

sentences.en: You have wanted to get rid of President Trump since he was sworn in, since he was elected.
sentences.zh: 从特朗普总统宣誓就职，从他当选的那一刻起，你们就一直想除掉他。

sentences.en: First, they insisted that the president is a Russian agent.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们坚称总统是俄罗斯的特工。

sentences.en: Then they claimed he's a money launderer and a tax cheat and a fraudulent businessman.
sentences.zh: 后来他们又声称他是洗钱者、逃税者和欺诈商人。

sentences.en: And now they've decided they don't like the way he talks to foreign leaders.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们又决定不喜欢他与外国领导人交谈的方式。

sentences.en: This is just one more effort to essentially undo the results of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 这只不过是又一次试图从根本上推翻2016年选举结果的努力。

sentences.en: You didn't like them, and you are trying to reverse the will of the people.
sentences.zh: 你们不喜欢选举结果，所以你们正试图扭转民意。

sentences.en: And Kevin McCarthy, the Republican leader, even says...
sentences.zh: 共和党领袖凯文·麦卡锡甚至说……

sentences.en: Why do you not trust the people?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么不信任人民？

sentences.en: Why do you not allow the people to have a voice?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么不允许人民发出声音？

sentences.en: You have no right to come in here and start this process that essentially nullifies an election.
sentences.zh: 你们无权来到这里，开启这个从根本上废除选举结果的程序。

sentences.en: The curtain is coming down on this House because the majority has no idea about process and procedure.
sentences.zh: 众议院的帷幕即将落下，因为多数党根本不懂流程和程序。

sentences.en: They're simply after a president.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在针对一位总统。

sentences.en: I yield back.
sentences.zh: 我交回剩余时间。

sentences.en: And finally, Republicans said that, you know, these rules, they don't give the president a fair shake.
sentences.zh: 最后，共和党人说，你们知道，这些规则并没有给总统公平的待遇。

sentences.en: They don't give Republicans the same rights even that they've had in previous impeachments.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至没有给予共和党人在以往弹劾案中享有的同等权利。

sentences.en: And therefore, we would never vote for them anyway, even if we thought that this was a legitimate thing to do.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使我们认为这是一件合情合理的事情，我们也绝不会投票支持它们。

sentences.en: And Julie, is that true?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: I noticed several of these House Republicans saying...
sentences.zh: 我注意到几位众议院共和党人说……

sentences.en: The process laid out in the resolution before us is different from the process used for both
sentences.zh: 我们面前这项决议所规定的程序，与1974年的尼克松总统

sentences.en: President Nixon in 1974 and President Clinton in 1998.
sentences.zh: 和1998年的克林顿总统所使用的程序不同。

sentences.en: That the rules set forth on Thursday were not as robust for the minority party as rules put in place in the Nixon and the Clinton impeachment processes.
sentences.zh: 周四提出的规则对少数党而言，不如尼克松和克林顿弹劾程序中制定的规则那样稳健。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 这是真的吗？

sentences.en: It is accurate for now insofar as the House is in an investigative phase of this inquiry.
sentences.zh: 就目前众议院处于调查阶段而言，这种说法是准确的。

sentences.en: And in the House Intelligence Committee, there is no right for the president to defend himself.
sentences.zh: 在众议院情报委员会，总统没有权利为自己辩护。

sentences.en: There's no right for his counsel to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 他的律师也没有权利提问。

sentences.en: But as soon as this moves into the realm of the Judiciary Committee and they're actually
sentences.zh: 但一旦进入司法委员会的领域，他们实际上开始

sentences.en: considering articles of impeachment, that is when a lot of these rights and responsibilities that are outlined in the rules kick in.
sentences.zh: 审议弹劾条款时，规则中概述的许多权利和责任就会生效。

sentences.en: And so Democrats say, and if you just look at the procedures from today and from back then, they are very similar.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人说，如果你看看今天和当时的程序，它们是非常相似的。

sentences.en: The Republicans do have the right to ask for subpoenas of witnesses and testimony to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 共和党人确实有权要求传唤证人并要求证词，也有权提问。

sentences.en: And yes, it is the case that the Democrats, as the majority party, have more say over that process than the Republicans will.
sentences.zh: 是的，作为多数党，民主党在程序上的话语权确实比共和党大。

sentences.en: But the rights are really there as soon as they get into the phase of this process that is impeachment articles against the president.
sentences.zh: 但一旦进入针对总统的弹劾条款这一阶段，这些权利就真正存在了。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, I get it.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，我明白了。

sentences.en: My friends on the other side of the aisle want to talk about process, process, process.
sentences.zh: 我那边的朋友们想谈论程序、程序、还是程序。

sentences.en: But it's interesting that not one of them wants to talk about the president's conduct.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，他们中没有一个人想谈论总统的行为。

sentences.en: And that speaks volumes.
sentences.zh: 这说明了一切。

sentences.en: And what's the case, Julie, that the Democrats are making?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，民主党人提出的理由是什么？

sentences.en: They have, of course, written these rules and they're very much in charge of this process.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些规则是他们制定的，他们非常主导这个过程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the Democrats are trying to make a very kind of somber case about this being not a political process, but really their duty as people who have taken an oath to the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人正试图提出一种非常严肃的理由，即这不仅仅是一个政治过程，而是他们作为对宪法宣誓过的人的职责。

sentences.en: I support this resolution not because I want the allegations to be true.
sentences.zh: 我支持这项决议，不是因为我希望这些指控是真的。

sentences.en: They sadden me deeply.
sentences.zh: 它们让我深感悲痛。

sentences.en: But because if they are true, the Constitution demands that we take action.
sentences.zh: 但如果它们是真的，宪法要求我们采取行动。

sentences.en: This is the way they're going to defend the Constitution and that they have to hold the president accountable, that it's their role as the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们捍卫宪法的方式，他们必须让总统承担责任，这是他们作为众议院的角色。

sentences.en: We don't work for this president or any president.
sentences.zh: 我们不是为这位总统或任何总统工作的。

sentences.en: We work for the American people.
sentences.zh: 我们是为美国人民工作的。

sentences.en: To dig into what happened and uphold the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 去挖掘真相并维护宪法。

sentences.en: And this is, they're saying, the only way to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这是做到这一点的唯一途径。

sentences.en: We have a constitutional responsibility to serve as a check and balance on an out-of-control executive branch.
sentences.zh: 我们有宪法责任，作为对失控的行政部门的制衡。

sentences.en: They also really take aim at the way the president and Republicans have kind of targeted the witnesses so far who have appeared behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 他们还真正针对总统和共和党人迄今为止对待闭门作证证人的方式。

sentences.en: Some dedicated public servants have demonstrated their patriotism to this great country by coming forward and testifying and giving us the information as they know it.
sentences.zh: 一些敬业的公职人员通过挺身而出、作证并提供他们所知的真实信息，展示了他们对这个伟大国家的爱国精神。

sentences.en: These brave patriots have been called to rail radical, unelected bureaucrats.
sentences.zh: 这些勇敢的爱国者被称为激进的、未经选举的官僚。

sentences.en: They've been called that by a group of people who Thomas Paine would call summer soldiers and sunshine patriots.
sentences.zh: 他们被一群托马斯·潘恩会称之为“夏季士兵”和“阳光爱国者”的人这样称呼。

sentences.en: These people are serving their country, they're upstanding people, and essentially defending kind of the nuts and bolts of what they're learning here in this inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这些人正在为国家服务，他们是正直的人，本质上是在捍卫他们在此次调查中所了解到的核心事实。

sentences.en: After today, there are no more excuses for those who want to ignore the facts and instead defending the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 今天之后，对于那些想要无视事实而不是捍卫宪法的人来说，再也没有借口了。

sentences.en: And there are no more excuses for those who turn a blind eye while the president pressures foreign actors to interfere with our democracy.
sentences.zh: 对于那些在总统向外国势力施压以干预我们民主时视而不见的人，也没有借口了。

sentences.en: So essentially, trying to make it really hard to dismiss the revelations that have come out so far and kind of promoting their own role in having brought that all forth.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，他们试图让人们很难驳回目前披露的真相，并以此宣传他们在揭露这一切中所发挥的作用。

sentences.en: And as the debate is wrapping up, Speaker Nancy Pelosi gets up to speak.
sentences.zh: 辩论即将结束时，南希·佩洛西议长起身发言。

sentences.en: I thank the gentleman for yielding, and, Madam Speaker, thank you for the recognition.
sentences.zh: 感谢这位先生让出时间，议长女士，感谢您的认可。

sentences.en: She has a placard next to her of the American flag.
sentences.zh: 她旁边放着一面美国国旗的标语牌。

sentences.en: I proudly stand next to the flag, and I thank the gentleman from New York for providing it for us, this flag.
sentences.zh: 我自豪地站在国旗旁，感谢纽约的那位先生为我们提供了这面旗帜。

sentences.en: So many have fought and died for this flag, which stands for our democracy.
sentences.zh: 许多人为这面旗帜而战并献出了生命，它代表着我们的民主。

sentences.en: And she talks about the legislative branch and what their role is.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了立法部门及其角色。

sentences.en: And the genius of that Constitution was the separation of powers.
sentences.zh: 宪法的天才之处在于权力的分立。

sentences.en: Any usurping of that power is a violation of our oath of office.
sentences.zh: 任何对权力的篡夺都是对我们就职誓言的违背。

sentences.en: And clearly, the case that she's making is that impeachment is a constitutional endeavor.
sentences.zh: 显然，她提出的理由是弹劾是一项宪法事业。

sentences.en: And this Constitution is the blueprint for our republic and not a monarchy.
sentences.zh: 这部宪法是我们共和国的蓝图，而不是君主制。

sentences.en: So what is at stake is our democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以，危在旦夕的是我们的民主。

sentences.en: What are we fighting for?
sentences.zh: 我们在为什么而战？

sentences.en: Defending our democracy for the people.
sentences.zh: 为了人民捍卫我们的民主。

sentences.en: What we've been hearing from Republicans throughout this debate is the political aspect of impeachment, which is undeniable.
sentences.zh: 我们在整个辩论中从共和党人那里听到的是弹劾的政治层面，这是不可否认的。

sentences.en: But she's really trying to spotlight the constitutional nature of this process and trying to get people to focus on that.
sentences.zh: 但她确实试图突出这一过程的宪法性质，并试图让人们关注这一点。

sentences.en: And so that is essentially the case that she makes.
sentences.zh: 这就是她提出的基本理由。

sentences.en: And she kind of wraps up and she says, what is at stake is nothing less than our democracy.
sentences.zh: 她在总结时说，危在旦夕的正是我们的民主。

sentences.en: And that is how we will honor our oath of office.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将如何履行就职誓言。

sentences.en: I urge an aye vote, and you'll back the balance of my time.
sentences.zh: 我敦促投赞成票，我交回剩余时间。

sentences.en: I wonder what struck you about all of these speeches at this moment in the day, Democratic and Republican.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，在这一天里，这些民主党和共和党的演讲中，有什么让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: Probably something like two dozen or so of these.
sentences.zh: 大概有两打左右吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I think what we saw was two parties sort of talking past each other.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们看到的是两个政党在各说各话。

sentences.en: And that was the most striking element.
sentences.zh: 这是最引人注目的元素。

sentences.en: And to me, it just really spoke profoundly of what we are about to see unfold here as the impeachment goes public, that you are going to have this real battle with the Republicans
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这深刻地预示了随着弹劾公开化，我们将在这里看到什么，你将看到共和党和民主党之间真正的较量，

sentences.en: and Democrats, both in their partisan corners, in many ways, kind of talking past and around each other about what is really going on here.
sentences.zh: 双方都固守自己的党派立场，在很多方面各说各话，围绕着这里真正发生的事情进行争论。

sentences.en: I urge my colleagues to support this resolution.
sentences.zh: 我敦促我的同事们支持这项决议。

sentences.en: I yield back my time, and I move the previous question and the resolution.
sentences.zh: 我交回我的时间，并提议进行前项表决和决议表决。

sentences.en: So once these speeches are all done, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些演讲结束后，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So after all the speeches are over, there is a procedural vote where Republicans essentially try to block the resolution from coming up altogether, and that fails.
sentences.zh: 演讲结束后，会进行一次程序性投票，共和党人试图阻止该决议的提出，但失败了。

sentences.en: And then it's time for the big vote.
sentences.zh: 然后就是大投票的时间了。

sentences.en: Guys, I'm getting called by the desk.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，办公桌那边在叫我。

sentences.en: I think I might have to jump.
sentences.zh: 我想我得走了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You think you'll be able to come back?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你能回来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我可以。

sentences.en: Well, let me just go upstairs and see what's happening, and then I might be able to come down in like 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我上去看看发生了什么，然后我可能在大约10分钟后下来。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Julie, what happens in this vote?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，这次投票结果如何？

sentences.en: So, when it's time for the vote, Nancy Pelosi, the Speaker of the House, goes up to the rostrum in the front of the House chamber.
sentences.zh: 投票开始时，众议院议长南希·佩洛西走上众议院大厅前方的讲台。

sentences.en: It's very unusual for the Speaker of the House to actually preside, especially during a vote.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长亲自主持会议是非常罕见的，尤其是在投票期间。

sentences.en: The question is on the adoption of the resolution.
sentences.zh: 问题在于是否通过该决议。

sentences.en: Those in favor, please say aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成者，请说赞成。

sentences.en: And she essentially asks for the yeas and nays.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是在要求口头表决。

sentences.en: Those opposed, say no.
sentences.zh: 反对者，请说反对。

sentences.en: And then Republicans ask for a roll call vote.
sentences.zh: 然后共和党人要求进行点名投票。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, on that I would request the yeas and nays.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，对此我要求进行点名表决。

sentences.en: They ask for the actual yeas and nays by electronic vote.
sentences.zh: 他们要求通过电子投票进行实际的点名表决。

sentences.en: So, essentially, what happens is the back wall lights up with red and green lights next to all the names.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，后墙上会亮起红灯和绿灯，显示在所有名字旁边。

sentences.en: And you can see in real time how they're all voting.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时看到他们是如何投票的。

sentences.en: This is a five-minute vote, colleagues.
sentences.zh: 同事们，这是一次五分钟的投票。

sentences.en: A five-minute vote.
sentences.zh: 五分钟投票。

sentences.en: So, the whole gallery at this point is filled with members of the public who are there to witness this historic vote.
sentences.zh: 此时，整个旁听席挤满了见证这一历史性投票的公众。

sentences.en: And on this vote, the yeas are 232.
sentences.zh: 在这次投票中，赞成票为232票。

sentences.en: The nays are 196.
sentences.zh: 反对票为196票。

sentences.en: The resolution is adopted without objection.
sentences.zh: 该决议在无异议的情况下获得通过。

sentences.en: The motion to reconsider is laid upon the table.
sentences.zh: 重新考虑的动议被搁置。

sentences.en: The resolution is passed.
sentences.zh: 决议通过。

sentences.en: And as it turns out, no Republicans decide to cross party lines.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，没有共和党人决定跨越党派界限。

sentences.en: They all vote no.
sentences.zh: 他们全部投了反对票。

sentences.en: And only two Democrats oppose it.
sentences.zh: 只有两名民主党人反对。

sentences.en: And who are those two Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那两名民主党人是谁？

sentences.en: And were they expected to oppose it?
sentences.zh: 他们是否被预期会反对？

sentences.en: The two Democrats were Colin Peterson, a congressman from Minnesota, and Jeff Van Drew, who is from New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 这两名民主党人是来自明尼苏达州的国会议员科林·彼得森，以及来自新泽西州的杰夫·范德鲁。

sentences.en: Colin Peterson has been in the House for decades.
sentences.zh: 科林·彼得森在众议院已经待了几十年了。

sentences.en: Jeff Van Drew is a first-term Democrat from a very conservative district in southern New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·范德鲁是来自新泽西州南部一个非常保守选区的第一任期民主党人。

sentences.en: And he had signaled before the vote that he was going to be a no.
sentences.zh: 他在投票前就已经暗示他会投反对票。

sentences.en: He's been very much against impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他一直非常反对弹劾。

sentences.en: He's said that Democrats shouldn't even be talking about it.
sentences.zh: 他说民主党人甚至不应该谈论这件事。

sentences.en: It's a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 这是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: He'd rather talk about policy.
sentences.zh: 他宁愿谈论政策。

sentences.en: And so, it was pretty clear that he was going to oppose this.
sentences.zh: 所以，很明显他会反对这一点。

sentences.en: Colin Peterson is also a pretty conservative Democrat.
sentences.zh: 科林·彼得森也是一位相当保守的民主党人。

sentences.en: He, interestingly, voted in favor of opening the inquiry into former President Bill Clinton back in 1998.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他在1998年曾投票支持对前总统比尔·克林顿展开调查。

sentences.en: But he was one of the two to vote no today.
sentences.zh: 但他今天却是投反对票的两人之一。

sentences.en: So, this is as partisan and party-line a vote as you can have in Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是国会中能见到的最党派化、最按党派路线进行的投票。

sentences.en: That was, I think, what Democrats expected it to be.
sentences.zh: 我想，这正是民主党人所预期的结果。

sentences.en: But it was also a necessary exercise, I think, because now they can move forward and actually put this impeachment inquiry into its next phase.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这也是一个必要的练习，因为现在他们可以向前推进，真正将这次弹劾调查带入下一个阶段。

sentences.en: So, now that these rules have passed in the House and the impeachment inquiry is operating in this new phase, under these new guidelines, what does that actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么，既然这些规则已经在众议院通过，弹劾调查正在这些新准则下进入新阶段，那实际上是什么样子的？

sentences.en: The hope is that they can move very quickly to public hearings.
sentences.zh: 希望他们能非常迅速地进入公开听证会阶段。

sentences.en: And those would feature some of the witnesses we've seen appearing behind closed doors, like Ambassador Bill Taylor, who is the top diplomat in the Ukraine, Fiona Hill,
sentences.zh: 届时将会有我们看到的一些闭门作证的证人出席，比如乌克兰最高外交官比尔·泰勒大使、菲奥娜·希尔，

sentences.en: Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: 戈登·桑德兰。

sentences.en: And there's a national security official who is still in the White House, Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Vindman,
sentences.zh: 还有一位目前仍在白宫任职的国家安全官员，陆军中校亚历山大·温德曼（Alexander Vindman），

sentences.en: and they think he would make a really compelling figure to take people through what this pressure campaign on Ukraine looked like and the ways in which foreign policy was kind of being bent in the interest of achieving President Trump's political goals.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他会是一个非常有说服力的人物，能带领人们了解针对乌克兰的这场施压行动是什么样的，以及外交政策是如何为了实现特朗普总统的政治目标而被扭曲的。

sentences.en: This is going to be very substantive questioning in long rounds by staff investigators who are essentially trying to press to get the clearest possible account of what transpired.
sentences.zh: 这将是非常实质性的质询，由工作人员调查员进行多轮长谈，他们本质上是在努力追问，以获得对所发生事件最清晰的描述。

sentences.en: It sounds like this is going to be a type of congressional hearing we're not really used to seeing.
sentences.zh: 听起来这将是我们不太习惯看到的那种国会听证会。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think the hope for Democrats is that people are really going to sit riveted and watch every moment because they have been reading and hearing about these accounts for now several weeks,
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党人的希望是，人们真的会全神贯注地观看每一个时刻，因为他们几周来一直在阅读和听说这些叙述，

sentences.en: but they haven't gotten a chance to really hear and see them firsthand.
sentences.zh: 但他们还没有机会亲耳听到和亲眼看到这些证词。

sentences.en: And so it's really important for Democrats to have these people describe what they saw on camera in a way that the public can understand,
sentences.zh: 因此，对民主党人来说，让这些人以公众能理解的方式在镜头前描述他们所见所闻非常重要，

sentences.en: and then also so that they can draw up this report that they're hoping to present.
sentences.zh: 这样他们才能起草那份他们希望提交的报告。

sentences.en: And then at some point, they will draw up articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 然后在某个时候，他们会起草弹劾条款。

sentences.en: They're actually already being debated and deliberated over now.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这些条款现在已经在讨论和审议中了。

sentences.en: What would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子？

sentences.en: And there would be an official vote in the Judiciary Committee to send those to the full House.
sentences.zh: 司法委员会将进行正式投票，将这些条款提交给众议院全体会议。

sentences.en: Sometime in early December, they're hoping by late in the month.
sentences.zh: 他们希望在12月初，或者本月下旬完成。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But that's obviously a lot of moving parts, a lot of boxes to check before they can get to an actual vote on impeaching President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但这显然涉及很多变数，在他们能够对弹劾特朗普总统进行实际投票之前，还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: And that is just the House process.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是众议院的程序。

sentences.en: When that is wrapped up, it sounds like by the end of the year, it then would head to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 当这一切结束时，听起来是在年底之前，然后就会进入参议院。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They would then have formally charged the president, and the impeachment articles would move to the Senate for a trial.
sentences.zh: 届时他们将正式指控总统，弹劾条款将移交参议院进行审判。

sentences.en: Julie, if you are the House Democratic leadership, I wonder, does what happened on Thursday look like a pretty successful strategy that's finally come to life?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，如果你是众议院民主党领导层，我想知道，周四发生的事情看起来像是一个终于付诸实施的相当成功的策略吗？

sentences.en: Or is this just a massively risky political wager for the Democrats that could end up jeopardizing their majority in the House, make it impossible for them to retake the Senate,
sentences.zh: 还是说这对民主党人来说仅仅是一场风险巨大的政治赌博，最终可能会危及他们在众议院的多数席位，使他们无法夺回参议院，

sentences.en: and maybe even complicate their chances of winning the White House?
sentences.zh: 甚至可能让赢得白宫的机会变得更加复杂？

sentences.en: I think it is a massively risky endeavor for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对民主党人来说是一项风险巨大的事业。

sentences.en: But I also think it's one that they concluded over these many weeks was inescapable, that they have gotten to a point where their members,
sentences.zh: 但我同时也认为，这是他们经过这几周的考虑后认为不可避免的一步，他们已经到了这样一个地步，他们的成员，

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi and almost all of her rank and file, feel that the public is behind having an impeachment inquiry,
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西（Nancy Pelosi）和她几乎所有的普通议员，都觉得公众支持进行弹劾调查，

sentences.en: that they're not doing their jobs and shirking their responsibilities if they don't do it, and that at the very least,
sentences.zh: 如果他们不这样做，就是没有尽到职责，是在逃避责任，而且至少，

sentences.en: if they can't convince any Republicans to join them in supporting this,
sentences.zh: 如果他们无法说服任何共和党人加入他们的支持行列，

sentences.en: which it certainly looked from today like they won't be able to, that they can at least persuade the public that there was some misconduct here,
sentences.zh: 从今天的情况来看，他们显然无法做到这一点，那么他们至少可以向公众证明这里存在一些不当行为，

sentences.en: that there was some unpresidential behavior here.
sentences.zh: 这里存在一些不符合总统身份的行为。

sentences.en: And if President Trump is not removed, that they will at least have made their best possible case for why he shouldn't be president.
sentences.zh: 即使特朗普总统没有被免职，他们至少也已经为他为什么不应该担任总统提出了最有力的论据。

sentences.en: So, Julie, how should we think about the significance of what ended up happening today in the House of Representatives?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，我们应该如何看待今天众议院发生的事情的意义？

sentences.en: Well, it was really a historic vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是一次历史性的投票。

sentences.en: It was only the third time in modern history that the House has voted on an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这是现代历史上众议院第三次对弹劾调查进行投票。

sentences.en: And it really did put the House on this path to impeach the president to actually pass articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 它确实让众议院走上了弹劾总统的道路，即真正通过弹劾条款。

sentences.en: There's very little chance now that the House Democrats will ultimately opt out of bringing articles of impeachment against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 现在众议院民主党人最终选择不提出针对特朗普总统的弹劾条款的可能性非常小。

sentences.en: And so it's put them on this road to a very significant process.
sentences.zh: 所以这让他们走上了一个非常重要的进程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It feels like, in a way, there's kind of no going back at this point.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，感觉现在已经没有回头路了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: On paper, this was a vote about setting rules for considering articles of impeachment if the House decides to do that.
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，这是一次关于如果众议院决定考虑弹劾条款时应遵循何种规则的投票。

sentences.en: But in reality, it was a vote that makes it very clear that the House is going to bring articles of impeachment against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这次投票非常明确地表明，众议院将对特朗普总统提出弹劾条款。

sentences.en: And the only real question is whether he'll be convicted in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 而唯一真正的问题是，他是否会在参议院被定罪。

sentences.en: Thank you, Julie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，朱莉。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In testimony before impeachment investigators, the National Security Council's top expert on Russia became the latest official to describe a quid pro quo
sentences.zh: 在弹劾调查人员面前的证词中，国家安全委员会的俄罗斯问题首席专家成为最新一位描述“利益交换”的官员，

sentences.en: in which the president withheld U.S.
sentences.zh: 即总统扣留了美国的

sentences.en: military aid in order to pressure Ukraine's president to investigate Trump's rivals.
sentences.zh: 军事援助，以向乌克兰总统施压，要求其调查特朗普的竞争对手。

sentences.en: The expert, Tim Morrison, described a conversation in which Trump's ambassador to the European Union, Gordon Sondland,
sentences.zh: 这位专家蒂姆·莫里森（Tim Morrison）描述了一次谈话，其中特朗普的欧盟大使戈登·桑德兰（Gordon Sondland）

sentences.en: explained that the military aid to Ukraine would not be released until Ukraine committed to investigating Democrats.
sentences.zh: 解释说，在乌克兰承诺调查民主党人之前，对乌克兰的军事援助不会发放。

sentences.en: That testimony now corroborates a central claim in the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这份证词现在证实了弹劾调查中的一个核心主张。

sentences.en: Ann.
sentences.zh: 安。

sentences.en: This is the last speech that I will give from this floor as a member of Congress.
sentences.zh: 这是我作为国会议员最后一次在这个议事厅发表演讲。

sentences.en: I wasn't ready for my time here to come to an end so soon.
sentences.zh: 我还没准备好我在国会的时间这么快就结束。

sentences.en: It's a reality I'm still grappling with, and I will be for a long time to come.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我仍在努力接受的现实，而且在很长一段时间内我都会如此。

sentences.en: Representative Katie Hill, a freshman Democrat from California, resigned from Congress on Thursday in an emotional speech from the House floor.
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚州的民主党新晋众议员凯蒂·希尔（Katie Hill）周四在众议院发表了一场感人的演讲，宣布辞去国会议员职务。

sentences.en: Hill had faced a House ethics investigation into allegations she had a sexual relationship with a member of her congressional staff, a violation of congressional rules.
sentences.zh: 希尔曾面临众议院道德委员会的调查，指控她与一名国会工作人员有性关系，这违反了国会规定。

sentences.en: Hill has denied having a relationship with the congressional staff member, but has acknowledged a separate relationship with a member of her campaign team,
sentences.zh: 希尔否认与该国会工作人员有关系，但承认与她竞选团队的一名成员有过一段单独的关系，

sentences.en: a relationship that was the subject of graphic leaks to the news media that Hill said originated from her husband.
sentences.zh: 这段关系成为了新闻媒体泄露的露骨内容的主题，希尔称这些泄露源于她的丈夫。

sentences.en: To the thousands of people who spent hours knocking doors in the hot summer sun, who made countless phone calls, who sacrificed more than I could ever know
sentences.zh: 对于成千上万在炎炎夏日里挨家挨户敲门、打了无数个电话、做出了我无法想象的牺牲的人们，

sentences.en: to give everything they could in every possible way so that I could be here, I am so, so sorry.
sentences.zh: 为了让我能来到这里，他们竭尽所能付出了所有，我感到非常、非常抱歉。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig），讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
